title: Essential Commodities Act: 4-Tier Gas Allocation Framework
summary: **Statutory Invocation & Trigger:** Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas invoked Section 5 delegation powers under the **Essential Commodities Act (ECA), 1955*...

items: **Statutory Invocation & Trigger:** Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas invoked Section 5 delegation powers under the **Essential Commodities Act (ECA), 1955** to establish a nationwide emergency gas allocation grid in response to West Asian geopolitical supply strains.

**4-Tier Priority Allocation Grid:**
• **Priority 1 (100% Supply):** Domestic Piped Natural Gas (PNG), Compressed Natural Gas (CNG-Transport), and LPG domestic bottling.
• **Priority 2 (70% Supply Cap):** Agricultural fertilizer manufacturing units.
• **Priority 3 (80% Supply Cap):** National Gas Grid transmission networks.
• **Priority 4 (80% Supply Cap):** Industrial and commercial City Gas Distribution (CGD) entities.
**LPG Refill Cooling Period:** Mandatory minimum cooling period between consecutive domestic LPG cylinder refills increased from **21 days ➔ 25 days**.

blocks.content: 🎯 Exam Angle → LPG domestic cylinder refill waiting window increased from 21 to 25 days; Section 5 of ECA 1955.
